status: DRAFT: catalogue agreed as a starting point, not reviewed control by control

states.PRESENT: the control was found in the files read; `level` says how strongly (declared, configured, enforced in CI, verified at run time)
states.PARTIAL: found for part of the application, or configured but not shown to run
states.ABSENT: searched and not found in the files read (the result says which files and what for); when the repository names a place outside the scan that could hold it, the result is UNKNOWN instead
states.ISSUE: a fact that was read shows a problem (for example a runtime past vendor support, tests switched off)
states.UNKNOWN: cannot be decided from the files (for example a pipeline hidden in a remote template), or usually set outside the repository and not seen in it (confirm with the team)
states.NOT_APPLICABLE: does not apply to this kind of application; when that is because something was not found (no database, no HTTP client), the result says where it searched
states.NOT_ASSESSED: applies, but no detector exists yet or its input was not available

aspects.title: Build & delivery
aspects.question: Can a change reach production automatically and be undone?
aspects.why_first: Every other fix needs a pipeline to run in

aspects.title: Testing & safety net
aspects.question: Would a regression be caught before it ships?
aspects.why_first: Before upgrades: a safety net makes them verifiable

aspects.title: Security & supply chain
aspects.question: Are code, dependencies and secrets scanned, and is exposure known?
aspects.why_first: Runs in the same pipeline; independent of the others

aspects.title: Platform & dependencies
aspects.question: Is the runtime and framework supported, and are libraries current?
aspects.why_first: After the safety net, so behaviour changes are caught

aspects.title: Runtime resilience
aspects.question: Does the application survive slow or failing dependencies and restarts?
aspects.why_first: Needs tests that exercise failure paths

aspects.title: Deployment & availability
aspects.question: Does it keep serving through rollouts, node loss and load?
aspects.why_first: Needs the deploy stage from Build & delivery

aspects.title: Observability & operations
aspects.question: Would the team know it is failing, and why?
aspects.why_first: Measure before tuning resilience and capacity

aspects.title: API & contracts
aspects.question: Can consumers rely on a published, checked contract?
aspects.why_first: Independent; matters most for shared APIs

aspects.title: Data management
aspects.question: Are schema changes controlled and data recoverable?

aspects.title: Architecture & coupling
aspects.question: What does it depend on, and what depends on it?
aspects.why_first: Decides what has to change together

aspects.title: Code health
aspects.question: Is the code easy and safe to change?
aspects.why_first: Guides where to add tests first

aspects.title: Knowledge & ownership
aspects.question: Who owns it, and could someone new work on it?
aspects.why_first: Owners must be known to plan any of the above

aspects.title: Configuration hygiene
aspects.question: Is configuration externalised, consistent and free of secrets?

controls.title: Automated build in CI
controls.fix: Add a CI job that compiles and packages the application on every commit.

search.for: a CI step that runs the Maven or Gradle build

controls.title: Tests run in the pipeline
controls.fix: Run the test task in the pipeline and fail the build when a test fails.

search.for: a CI step that runs the tests (mvn test/verify, gradle test/check) without skipping them

controls.title: Automated version tagging
controls.fix: Have the pipeline create a version tag for every release.

search.for: a CI step that creates a version tag, a release plugin, or a version taken from a git tag

controls.title: Automated deploy
controls.fix: Add a deploy stage per environment.

search.for: a CI step that deploys (kubectl, helm, ansible-playbook, a deploy script or job)

controls.title: Automatic rollback
controls.fix: Roll back automatically when a deploy fails its checks.

search.for: a rollback step or automatic rollback setting (helm --atomic, a rollback job, a deployment circuit breaker)

controls.title: Unit tests exist
controls.fix: Add unit tests for each module, starting with the classes that change most.

search.for: test classes marked @Test (JUnit, TestNG, Kotest, Spock)

controls.title: Coverage gate (>= 75%) run in the pipeline
controls.fix: Configure a JaCoCo or Kover gate at 75% and run it in the pipeline.

search.for: a coverage tool (JaCoCo, Kover) with a minimum of 75% or more that the build or pipeline runs

controls.title: Integration tests
controls.fix: Add integration tests for the data and messaging paths.

search.for: integration-style tests (@SpringBootTest, Testcontainers, an integration source set)

controls.title: Acceptance tests
controls.fix: Add acceptance tests for the main user journeys.

search.for: feature files, acceptance or end-to-end test classes or directories, or a CI job that runs them

controls.title: Contract tests
controls.fix: Add consumer contract tests for every API this application calls.

search.for: Pact or Spring Cloud Contract dependencies, or contract files

controls.title: Performance tests
controls.fix: Add a load test for the busiest endpoints.

search.for: Gatling, JMeter, k6 or Locust files or dependencies

controls.title: Entry points reached by a test
controls.fix: Add tests that reach the unmapped endpoints, consumers and data paths.

search.for: a test that reaches each endpoint, listener or data path, by route or class name

controls.title: Secret scanning in CI
controls.fix: Add a secret-scanning job (for example GitGuardian) to the pipeline.

search.for: GitGuardian, gitleaks or TruffleHog in a CI file, build file or tool configuration

controls.title: Dependency scanning in CI
controls.fix: Add a dependency-scanning job (for example Snyk) to the pipeline.

search.for: Snyk, OWASP Dependency-Check, Trivy, OSV-Scanner or GitLab dependency scanning in a CI file or build file

controls.title: Static code scanning (SAST) in CI
controls.fix: Add a SAST job to the pipeline.

search.for: SonarQube, Semgrep, CodeQL, SpotBugs/FindSecBugs or GitLab SAST in a CI file or build file

controls.title: Automated dependency updates
controls.fix: Turn on automated dependency update pull requests (Renovate or Dependabot).

search.for: a Dependabot or Renovate configuration file

controls.title: Vulnerability exposure known
controls.fix: Run a vulnerability scan so exposure is known, not assumed.

controls.title: No secrets committed in code, build or pipeline files
controls.fix: Move secrets to a secret store and rotate any that were committed.

search.for: secret-looking values (keys, tokens, passwords) in source, build and CI files

controls.title: Java version in vendor support
controls.fix: Move to a supported Java LTS; run change impact for the target version first.

controls.title: Framework version in support
controls.fix: Upgrade the framework (Spring Boot, Dropwizard, ...) to a supported line; run change impact first.

controls.title: Libraries current, none end of life

source.pending: library age and end-of-life reference data

controls.fix: Upgrade end-of-life and long-outdated libraries.

controls.title: Outbound HTTP calls have timeouts
controls.fix: Set connect and read timeouts, and a total deadline, on every HTTP client.

search.for: connect and read timeouts on the HTTP clients built in code or set in application configuration

controls.title: Retries and circuit breakers where calls can fail
controls.fix: Add bounded retries with backoff for idempotent calls, and a circuit breaker around each remote dependency.

search.for: retry or circuit-breaker libraries and their use (Resilience4j, Spring Retry, Hystrix, Failsafe)

controls.title: Message failures handled (retry, dead letter)
controls.fix: Configure retries, a dead-letter topic or queue, and commit offsets only after processing.

search.for: error handling on message consumers (a dead-letter topic or queue, an error handler, a retry policy)

controls.title: Database pool and query timeouts set
controls.fix: Size the connection pool and set connection and query timeouts.

search.for: connection and query timeouts on the database connection pool

controls.title: Graceful shutdown in the application
controls.fix: Enable graceful shutdown so in-flight requests finish on SIGTERM.

search.for: server.shutdown=graceful or the framework's shutdown timeout

controls.fix: Document and test backup, restore and failover.

controls.fix: Expose a health endpoint (for example Spring Boot Actuator health).

controls.title: Backups and restore tested

controls.title: Every call and message matched to a known application

controls.title: Complexity and duplication within limits

controls.title: Change hotspots known
